items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Simon Stewart and me, there was no band. Simon played and I sang.

ctx.x: There were so many different bands who played upstairs. The Pekin band was famous. Do you remember? The Pekin?
I mean combination. Well, that's alright. If you want to get your voice on here, it's alright too. Simon Stewart, yeah.
Simon Stewart and me, there was no band. Simon played and I sang.
